name: Payroll
description: Fast payroll calculation done by the kernel. Provided by Aether Enterprise; this edition accepts the declaration so plugins load, and a plugin that asks gets "unknown command" and calculates itself.

capabilities.name: Calculate Payslips
capabilities.description: Aether Enterprise only. Calculates payslips inside the kernel, natively and on every core, instead of in the plugin's WebAssembly, for large payrolls. In this edition the kernel commands payroll::calculate, payroll::write and payroll::sum_lines do not exist: a call answers `unknown command`, and a plugin must fall back to calculating in its own code (hr_payroll does).
